final_stage_task.latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the assigned reviser stage. The proposal keeps site causes unresolved, corrects the vibration and Emslie comparison caveats, and separates proposed pilot work from checks actually performed. The [FHWA handbook](https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/Environment/noise/measurement/handbook.cfm) confirms that indoor sound alone may not distinguish transmission paths; the [AAS2008 paper](https://www.acoustics.asn.au/conference_proceedings/AAS2008/papers/p64.pdf) reports measurements at different boundary positions, not a matched before-and-after comparison.

- [final.md](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/C-R1-01/treatment/stages/reviser/final.md) — complete proposal and navigable source index.
- [source-map.json](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/C-R1-01/treatment/stages/reviser/source-map.json) — all 12 source IDs, identity details, and review dispositions.
- Native Goal activation and completion responses are preserved in [native-goal-activation.json](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/C-R1-01/treatment/stages/reviser/native-goal-activation.json) and [native-goal-completion.json](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/C-R1-01/treatment/stages/reviser/native-goal-completion.json).
